name: civic_search_genes
description: Search for genes in CIViC (Clinical Interpretation of Variants in Cancer) database. Returns exact totalCount and cursor pagination metadata. When metadata.has_more is true, pass metadata.next_cursor as after with the same gene filter.

limit.description: Maximum number of genes to return (default: 10, recommended max: 100)

name.description: Gene symbol to search for (e.g., "EGFR", "BRAF", "BRCA1"). Alias: use 'query' or 'gene_name' instead.

query.description: Gene symbol to search for (e.g., "FLT3", "KRAS", "TP53"). Alias for 'name'.

gene_name.description: Gene symbol to search for. Alias for 'name'.

fields.query: query GetGenes($limit: Int, $after: String, $entrezSymbols: [String!]) { genes(first: $limit, after: $after, entrezSymbols: $entrezSymbols) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name description entrezId } } }

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the query in CIViC, independent of how many were returned in this page. Use this as the denominator; len(nodes) is only the page size.

hasNextPage.description: True when more records match than were returned; the returned nodes are an incomplete sample of totalCount.

endpoint.description: The CIViC GraphQL endpoint the data came from, e.g. 'https://civicdb.org/api/graphql'.

has_more.description: True when further pages exist, e.g. true.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, e.g. 'NQ'. CIViC pages by cursor, not by offset, so this value must be passed through verbatim.

returned.description: How many rows this reply contains, e.g. 5.

total_results.description: How many genes match the query in total, e.g. 754 -- against the 5 rows returned. This is the field that says the reply is a page.

total_results_is_exact.description: True when total_results is an exact count rather than a lower bound, e.g. true.

name: civic_get_variants_by_gene
description: Get variants associated with a specific gene in CIViC. Returns variant IDs, names, the exact totalCount, and cursor pagination metadata. Use gene_name or gene_symbol (e.g., 'EGFR', 'BRAF') for convenience, or gene_id if already known. When metadata.has_more is true, pass metadata.next_cursor as after to retrieve the next page.

gene_id.description: CIViC gene ID (e.g., 19 for EGFR, 12 for BRAF). Find gene IDs using civic_search_genes.

gene_name.description: Gene symbol (e.g., 'EGFR', 'BRAF', 'TP53'). Will be looked up automatically. Aliases: gene, gene_symbol, query.

gene_symbol.description: Alias for gene_name. Standard gene symbol (e.g., 'KRAS', 'BRCA1', 'EGFR').

limit.description: Maximum number of variants to return (default: 500, uses cursor pagination to bypass CIViC's 100/page server cap)

after.description: Opaque CIViC continuation cursor. Pass metadata.next_cursor from the preceding call with the same gene filter.

fields.query: query GetVariantsByGene($gene_id: Int!, $page_size: Int, $after: String) { gene(id: $gene_id) { id name variants(first: $page_size, after: $after) { totalCount nodes { id name ... on GeneVariant { feature { id name } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the query in CIViC, independent of how many were returned in this page. Use this as the denominator; len(nodes) is only the page size.

hasNextPage.description: True when more records match than were returned; the returned nodes are an incomplete sample of totalCount.

note.description: Optional note about duplicate variant names or other data quality observations

name: civic_get_variant
description: Get a specific CIViC variant by variant ID. Returns the variant's aliases and types, its genomic coordinates (reference build, chromosome, start, stop, reference and variant bases, representative transcript), the ClinGen allele registry id, the MANE Select transcript, the gene feature, ClinVar ids and HGVS descriptions. Associated molecular profiles are cursor-paginated: when metadata.molecular_profiles_has_more is true, pass metadata.next_molecular_profile_cursor as molecular_profile_after.

molecular_profile_limit.description: Maximum associated molecular profiles to return on this page (default: 5, maximum: 100)

fields.query: query GetVariant($variant_id: Int!, $molecular_profile_limit: Int, $molecular_profile_after: String) { variant(id: $variant_id) { id name link variantAliases variantTypes { id name soid } molecularProfiles(first: $molecular_profile_limit, after: $molecular_profile_after) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name molecularProfileScore } } ... on GeneVariant { clinvarIds hgvsDescriptions alleleRegistryId maneSelectTranscript feature { id name } coordinates { referenceBuild ensemblVersion chromosome start stop representativeTranscript referenceBases variantBases coordinateType } } } }

molecularProfiles.description: Molecular profiles this variant participates in.

totalCount.description: Total number of molecular profiles for this variant in CIViC, independent of how many were returned in this page. Use this as the denominator; len(nodes) is only the page size.

hasNextPage.description: True when more molecular profiles match than were returned; the returned nodes are an incomplete sample of totalCount.

clinvarIds.description: ClinVar variation ids for the variant, e.g. ['12624']. The join to clinical significance assertions outside CIViC.

hgvsDescriptions.description: HGVS strings for the variant, e.g. ['NM_007313.2:c.1001C>T', ...] - 4 of them, across transcripts and at protein level. Which transcript each is on decides whether a caller's own HGVS matches.

variantAliases.description: Other names for the variant, e.g. ['THR334ILE', ...]. Non-HGVS forms that appear in papers, which is how a literature mention is matched.

variantTypes.description: The variant's classes, each with id and name, e.g. 'Missense Variant'. A list, since one variant can be several things at once.

name: civic_search_variants
description: Search for variants in CIViC database. The tool follows CIViC's 100-record GraphQL pages up to limit and returns exact totalCount plus pageInfo. If pageInfo.hasNextPage is true, pass pageInfo.endCursor as after to continue. Use query to search by variant name, or gene/gene_name to get variants for a gene.

limit.description: Maximum number of variants to return across server pages (default: 20, max: 1000).

query.description: Variant name to search for (e.g., "T790M", "V600E", "exon 19 deletion"). Returns name-matching variants.

gene.description: Gene symbol to filter variants by (e.g., 'EGFR', 'BRAF', 'KRAS'). Returns all variants for that gene.

variant_name.description: Specific variant name to filter within a gene (e.g., 'L858R', 'V600E', 'T790M'). Use together with gene_name — CIViC stores variants without the gene prefix (use 'L858R' not 'EGFR L858R'). Gene-prefixed clinical spellings ('EGFRvIII', 'BRAFV600E') are still handled: the gene-stripped designation is queried as well and both result sets are merged, reported in normalization_note.

after.description: Opaque CIViC continuation cursor from a previous pageInfo.endCursor.

fields.query: query SearchVariants($query: String, $limit: Int, $after: String) { variants(name: $query, first: $limit, after: $after) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name ... on GeneVariant { feature { id name } } } } }

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the query in CIViC, independent of how many were returned in this page. Use this as the denominator; len(nodes) is only the page size.

hasNextPage.description: True when more records match than were returned; the returned nodes are an incomplete sample of totalCount.

endCursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results. Required to page a GraphQL connection; a page count will not do it.

name: civic_get_evidence_item
description: Get a specific CIViC evidence item by evidence ID. Evidence items link molecular profiles or variants to clinical outcomes, therapies, or disease states with curated literature support. Returns the evidence level (A-E), type, direction, significance and curator rating, the disease (with DOID), therapies, phenotypes (with HPO ids) and molecular profile, variant origin, and the full source record: PubMed/ASCO id (citationId), title, journal, authors, publication year and URL -- including whether the source has been RETRACTED (retracted, retractionDate, retractionNature, retractionReasons), which a caller must check before relying on the evidence.

fields.query: query GetEvidenceItem($evidence_id: Int!) { evidenceItem(id: $evidence_id) { id name description status link evidenceLevel evidenceType evidenceDirection significance evidenceRating variantOrigin therapyInteractionType disease { id name doid link } therapies { id name ncitId link } phenotypes { id name hpoId } molecularProfile { id name link } source { id citation citationId sourceType title journal fullJournalTitle authorString publicationYear publicationDate pmcId sourceUrl link openAccess isPreprint retracted retractionDate retractionNature retractionReasons } } }

evidenceType.description: PREDICTIVE, DIAGNOSTIC, PROGNOSTIC, PREDISPOSING, ONCOGENIC or FUNCTIONAL.

citationId.description: Identifier within sourceType -- the PMID for PUBMED sources.

retracted.description: True when the source publication has been retracted. Check this before relying on the evidence.

name: civic_search_evidence_items
description: Search CIViC evidence items with exact totalCount and cursor pagination. Each row carries the evidence level, type, direction, significance and curator rating, the disease (with DOID), therapies and molecular profile, and a resolvable source: citationId (the PMID for PUBMED sources), title, journal, year, URL, and whether the publication has been RETRACTED. When metadata.has_more is true, pass metadata.next_cursor as after with the same filters.

limit.description: Maximum evidence items to return across server pages (default: 20, max: 1000).

status.description: Filter by curation status. Default: ACCEPTED (peer-reviewed). Options: ACCEPTED, SUBMITTED, REJECTED, ALL (returns all statuses combined).

therapy.description: Filter by therapy/drug name (e.g., 'imatinib', 'pembrolizumab'). Alias: therapy_name. Note: matches any evidence item where the therapy appears, including combination regimens — results may include multi-drug combinations.

therapy_name.description: Alias for therapy. Filter by therapy/drug name.

disease.description: Filter by disease name (e.g., 'leukemia', 'melanoma', 'lung cancer'). Alias: disease_name. Note: CIViC uses specific disease names (e.g., 'Lung Non-small Cell Carcinoma', not 'NSCLC'); try partial names or multiple searches if results are empty.

disease_name.description: Alias for disease. Filter by disease name.

molecular_profile.description: Filter by molecular profile name (e.g., 'BRAF V600E', 'EGFR T790M', 'KRAS G12C'). Uses substring matching — 'FLT3 ITD' will also match 'FLT3 ITD AND FLT3 D835Y'. For gene fusions, CIViC uses double-colon notation: 'GENE::PARTNER Fusion' (e.g., 'FGFR2::BICC1 Fusion', 'ALK::EML4 Fusion'). Use civic_search_molecular_profiles to discover exact profile names. Gene-prefixed clinical spellings ('EGFRvIII', 'BRAFV600E') are also handled: CIViC names the profile '<gene> <designation>' ('EGFR VIII'), so that separated form is queried too and both result sets are merged, reported in normalization_note.

evidence_type.description: Filter by evidence type. Values: PREDICTIVE (drug response), DIAGNOSTIC (disease diagnosis), PROGNOSTIC (patient outcomes), PREDISPOSING (disease risk), ONCOGENIC (variant pathogenicity), FUNCTIONAL (molecular function).

significance.description: Filter by clinical significance. Values depend on evidence_type, e.g. SENSITIVITYRESPONSE, RESISTANCE (predictive); BETTER_OUTCOME, POOR_OUTCOME (prognostic); POSITIVE, NEGATIVE (diagnostic); ONCOGENIC, PROTECTIVE. Use to separate, e.g., resistance from sensitivity evidence for a variant.

after.description: Opaque CIViC continuation cursor from a previous pageInfo.endCursor.

fields.query: query SearchEvidenceItems($limit: Int, $after: String, $status: EvidenceStatusFilter, $therapyName: String, $diseaseName: String, $molecularProfileName: String, $evidenceType: EvidenceType, $significance: EvidenceSignificance, $evidenceDirection: EvidenceDirection) { evidenceItems(first: $limit, after: $after, status: $status, therapyName: $therapyName, diseaseName: $diseaseName, molecularProfileName: $molecularProfileName, evidenceType: $evidenceType, significance: $significance, evidenceDirection: $evidenceDirection) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name evidenceRating description evidenceLevel evidenceType evidenceDirection significance status disease { id name doid } therapies { id name ncitId } molecularProfile { id name } source { id citation citationId sourceType title journal publicationYear sourceUrl retracted } } } }

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the query in CIViC, independent of how many were returned in this page. Use this as the denominator; len(nodes) is only the page size.

hasNextPage.description: True when more records match than were returned; the returned nodes are an incomplete sample of totalCount.

endCursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results. Required to page a GraphQL connection; a page count will not do it.

citationId.description: Identifier within sourceType -- the PMID for PUBMED sources.

retracted.description: True when the source publication has been retracted. Check before relying on the evidence.

normalization_note.description: What the tool changed about the query before running it, e.g. "Input auto-normalized: therapy 'imatinib' -> ...". The search that ran is not the search that was asked for, and this is the only record of the difference.

status_note.description: Which evidence items were included, e.g. 'Showing 5 ACCEPTED (peer-reviewed) evidence items...'. CIViC also holds submitted and rejected items; a count read without this reads as the whole evidence base.

name: civic_get_assertion
description: Get a specific CIViC assertion by assertion ID. Assertions are higher-level clinical interpretations that integrate multiple evidence items into formal statements about clinical actionability. Returns the assertion's type and direction, its clinical significance, its AMP/ASCO/CAP tier (ampLevel) and any ACMG/ClinGen codes, the disease (with DOID) and therapies it concerns, the molecular profile it is made on, variant origin, whether an FDA companion test and regulatory approval exist, the NCCN guideline and version, how many evidence items support it (evidenceItemsCount), and the curated description and summary.

fields.query: query GetAssertion($assertion_id: Int!) { assertion(id: $assertion_id) { id name description summary status link assertionType assertionDirection significance ampLevel variantOrigin fdaCompanionTest regulatoryApproval evidenceItemsCount nccnGuideline { id name } nccnGuidelineVersion therapyInteractionType acmgCodes { code description } clingenCodes { code description } disease { id name doid link } therapies { id name ncitId link } molecularProfile { id name link } } }

assertionType.description: PREDICTIVE, DIAGNOSTIC, PROGNOSTIC, PREDISPOSING, ONCOGENIC or FUNCTIONAL.

ampLevel.description: AMP/ASCO/CAP tier, e.g. TIER_I_LEVEL_A. Null when not tiered.

variantOrigin.description: SOMATIC, GERMLINE, MIXED, NA or UNKNOWN.

fdaCompanionTest.description: An FDA companion diagnostic exists for this assertion.

regulatoryApproval.description: The therapy has regulatory approval in this context.

evidenceItemsCount.description: How many evidence items the assertion integrates.

therapyInteractionType.description: COMBINATION, SEQUENTIAL or SUBSTITUTES when several therapies.

name: civic_search_assertions
description: Search CIViC assertions with exact totalCount and cursor pagination. Each row carries the assertion's type, direction, significance, AMP/ASCO/CAP tier (ampLevel), variant origin, evidence count, disease (with DOID), therapies and molecular profile, so a result set can be triaged without a civic_get_assertion call per row. When metadata.has_more is true, pass metadata.next_cursor as after with the same filters.

limit.description: Maximum number of assertions to return (default: 20, recommended max: 100)

therapy.description: Filter by therapy/drug name (e.g., 'imatinib', 'ponatinib'). Alias: therapy_name.

therapy_name.description: Alias for therapy. Filter by therapy/drug name.

disease.description: Filter by disease name (e.g., 'leukemia', 'melanoma'). Alias: disease_name.

disease_name.description: Alias for disease. Filter by disease name.

fields.query: query SearchAssertions($limit: Int, $after: String, $therapyName: String, $diseaseName: String, $variantName: String) { assertions(first: $limit, after: $after, therapyName: $therapyName, diseaseName: $diseaseName, variantName: $variantName) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name summary status assertionType assertionDirection significance ampLevel variantOrigin evidenceItemsCount disease { id name doid } therapies { id name } molecularProfile { id name } } } }

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the query in CIViC, independent of how many were returned in this page. Use this as the denominator; len(nodes) is only the page size.

hasNextPage.description: True when more records match than were returned; the returned nodes are an incomplete sample of totalCount.

assertionType.description: PREDICTIVE, DIAGNOSTIC, PROGNOSTIC, PREDISPOSING, ONCOGENIC or FUNCTIONAL.

ampLevel.description: AMP/ASCO/CAP tier, e.g. TIER_I_LEVEL_A. Null when not tiered.

name: civic_get_molecular_profile
description: Get detailed information about a specific molecular profile in CIViC database by molecular profile ID. Molecular profiles represent combinations of variants or features (e.g., 'BRAF V600E') that serve as biomarkers for clinical interpretation. Associated evidence is cursor-paginated: when metadata.evidence_has_more is true, pass metadata.next_evidence_cursor as evidence_after to retrieve the next page.

molecular_profile_id.description: CIViC molecular profile ID (e.g., 12 for BRAF V600E)

evidence_limit.description: Maximum number of evidence items to return on this page (default: 10, maximum: 100)

fields.query: query GetMolecularProfile($molecular_profile_id: Int!, $evidence_limit: Int, $evidence_after: String) { molecularProfile(id: $molecular_profile_id) { id name molecularProfileScore description evidenceItems(first: $evidence_limit, after: $evidence_after) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name evidenceLevel evidenceDirection significance status disease { name } therapies { name } } } } }

description.description: Clinical description of the molecular profile

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the query in CIViC, independent of how many were returned in this page. Use this as the denominator; len(nodes) is only the page size.

hasNextPage.description: True when more records match than were returned; the returned nodes are an incomplete sample of totalCount.

name: civic_search_molecular_profiles
description: Search CIViC molecular profiles with exact totalCount and cursor pagination. When metadata.has_more is true, pass metadata.next_cursor as after.

limit.description: Maximum number of molecular profiles to return (default: 20, recommended max: 100)

query.description: Filter by molecular profile name (e.g., 'BRAF V600E', 'EGFR T790M', 'FLT3 ITD'). Returns profiles whose name contains this string. Alias: 'name'.

name.description: Alias for query. Filter by molecular profile name (e.g., 'PD-L1', 'KRAS G12C').

fields.query: query SearchMolecularProfiles($limit: Int, $after: String, $query: String) { molecularProfiles(first: $limit, after: $after, name: $query) { totalCount pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name } } }

totalCount.description: Total number of records matching the query in CIViC, independent of how many were returned in this page. Use this as the denominator; len(nodes) is only the page size.

hasNextPage.description: True when more records match than were returned; the returned nodes are an incomplete sample of totalCount.

name: civic_search_diseases
description: Search CIViC diseases with cursor pagination. CIViC publishes no filter-aware total for this browse table, so metadata.has_more is the completeness signal; continue with metadata.next_cursor as after while has_more is true.

limit.description: Maximum number of diseases to return (default: 20, recommended max: 100)

name.description: Filter by disease name (e.g., 'leukemia', 'melanoma', 'lung cancer'). Alias: query.

query.description: Alias for name. Filter by disease name.

fields.query: query SearchDiseases($limit: Int, $after: String, $name: String) { browseDiseases(first: $limit, after: $after, name: $name) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name } } }

pageInfo.description: Pagination state for this connection. This connection reports no filter-aware total, so hasNextPage is the only completeness signal available.

hasNextPage.description: True when more records match than were returned. This connection publishes no filter-aware total, so this is the only completeness signal available.

name: civic_search_therapies
description: Search CIViC therapies with cursor pagination. CIViC publishes no filter-aware total for this browse table, so metadata.has_more is the completeness signal; continue with metadata.next_cursor as after while has_more is true.

limit.description: Maximum number of therapies to return (default: 20, recommended max: 100)

name.description: Filter by therapy/drug name (e.g., 'imatinib', 'ponatinib', 'pembrolizumab'). Alias: query.

query.description: Alias for name. Filter by therapy/drug name.

fields.query: query SearchTherapies($limit: Int, $after: String, $name: String) { browseTherapies(first: $limit, after: $after, name: $name) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { id name } } }

pageInfo.description: Pagination state for this connection. This connection reports no filter-aware total, so hasNextPage is the only completeness signal available.

hasNextPage.description: True when more records match than were returned. This connection publishes no filter-aware total, so this is the only completeness signal available.
